_source: Declared by the operator, the owner of this machine, on 11 and 12 September 2026. Not measured.
_provenance: RAVIS records every entry here at CONFIGURED provenance. Measured evidence from SIRVIS outranks it, and should replace an entry once it exists.
_why: Anthropic's model catalogue publishes no tool support, so every Claude model bought directly stayed UNKNOWN for tools and failed closed in ravis/clarvis-agent, which requires tools. Every Clarvis agent session from 5 to 11 September went to qwen/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct as a result. Claude models accept tool definitions through the Messages API, and RAVIS's Anthropic translation carries tool calls both ways (src/ravis/providers/anthropic_wire.py). The operator chose Claude Sonnet 5, bought directly from Anthropic, for Clarvis's builds. On 12 September the operator also chose Claude Haiku 4.5, bought directly, for Clarvis's chat: its requests carry tools too, and the first one sent as the named caller clarvis went to gemini-2.5-flash-lite because Anthropic's own Haiku had no tool claim.
_scope: Only claude-sonnet-5 and claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Declaring every build of a family would tie them on a pool's preference, and with no published price for Anthropic's own models the tie falls to alphabetical order, which picks the oldest. Other Claude builds stay UNKNOWN until someone declares or measures them.
